name: Ola Electric
about: India's #1 EV scooter brand by sales. MoveOS 5 software, 36L boot, 90–117 km/h range across S1 series. Gen 3 launched 2026.

name: Ather Energy
about: India's premium EV brand. Best ride quality, Ather Grid fast-charging, 3.3 hr charge on 450X. Rizta is best-selling family scooter.

name: TVS Motor
about: India's most reliable EV service network — 4500+ centres nationwide. iQube ST 5.3 kWh delivers 212 km claimed range.

name: Bajaj Chetak
about: India's iconic scooter nameplate, revived electric. All-metal body, 35L boot, 4000+ dealers. C2501 to 3503 — 5 variants.

name: Hero Vida
about: Hero MotoCorp's EV arm. 6000+ Hero service points. VX2 has removable battery (BaaS model). Best hero service coverage in India.

name: Ampere
about: India's oldest EV brand (2008). 5000+ dealers in 500+ cities. LFP batteries in Nexus range. Tier-2/3 India's most accessible EV.

name: Okinawa
about: 10 years EV experience. 700+ dealers. Budget to mid-range. Okhi-90 is only Okinawa with 90 km/h. Entry R30 starts at ₹61,998.

name: Pure EV
about: IIT Hyderabad incubated. ETrance+ has 3G LTE, best real range in budget segment. Swappable batteries available.

name: Bounce Infinity
about: Battery-swap pioneer. E1 is India's lowest-priced EV with swap support. BaaS model eliminates battery cost upfront.

name: BGauss
about: RR Kabel backed Mumbai EV brand. Premium build quality above price. D15i and RUV 350i are flagship models.

name: Honda
about: Honda Motorcycle & Scooter India is the Indian two-wheeler arm of Honda Motor Co. Its electric scooters are sold under the e: line through dedicated EV dealers.

name: Suzuki
about: Suzuki Motorcycle India is the Indian two-wheeler subsidiary of Suzuki Motor Corporation. The e-Access, built at its Gurugram plant, is its first electric scooter.

name: Simple Energy
about: Simple Energy is a Bengaluru based electric two-wheeler maker that builds its scooters at a plant in Hosur, Tamil Nadu. Its range covers the Simple One, Simple Ultra and the family oriented Simple Wave.

name: Kinetic
about: Kinetic Watts and Volts Ltd. is the EV subsidiary of Kinetic Engineering Ltd., set up in 2022, and makes the electric Kinetic DX scooter at Ahmednagar, Maharashtra. It is a separate company from Kinetic Green.

name: Lectrix
about: Lectrix E-Vehicle Pvt. Ltd. is the electric two-wheeler brand of the SAR Group, which also owns Livguard and Livpure. Its head office is in Udyog Vihar, Gurugram, Haryana.

name: OPG Mobility (Okaya)
about: OPG Mobility is the electric vehicle business formerly sold as Okaya EV, which rebranded in 2025. It sells electric scooters, an electric motorcycle and electric three-wheelers, with its corporate office in Gurugram, Haryana.

name: VLF
about: VLF is an Italian scooter brand whose scooters are built in Zhejiang, China. In India it is sold and serviced by MotoHaus, based in Kolhapur, which brought the brand to India in 2024.
